title: brassica oleracea var. bullata
intro: Brassica oleracea var. bullata, commonly known as giant kohlrabi, is a plant species that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. It is a cool-season crop that has been cultivated for its edible stem and leaves. The health benefits of giant kohlrabi include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of giant kohlrabi include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial properties, while its bioactive constituents include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids.
